fun plan() {
  val registry = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val planBundle = compute(input = registry, op = "build judge workflow plan and certificate")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidenceObject = compute(input = taskContext, plan = planBundle, op = "echo gather verdict and grade each divergence")
  writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = evidenceObject)
  publish(channel = "safeoutputs:no-op", body = "No action needed: mm-compliance judge evidence written; gather had no divergences to grade.")
}
